claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Enerflex 之後的季報或 6-K 寫出表後發電在手訂單下降、專案取消或交期延到 2028 年以後，或 Engineered Systems 擴產投資縮減。核查頻率：每季（Enerflex 季報）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence，重讀現場燃氣發電層的機組整合商讀法。
claims.statement: Enerflex 6-K (2026-10-01): contracted to design, engineer, fabricate and assemble about 450 MW of behind-the-meter natural-gas-fired power generation units for a North American data center developer, built in its North American plants, deliveries 2027–2028. The developer is not named.

nodes.name: Onsite natural gas power generation for data centers

source_doc.permission_basis: SEC EDGAR 公開申報（6-K 附件新聞稿）；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。published_at 取新聞稿日期行「CALGARY, Alberta, October 1, 2026」。
source_doc.title: Enerflex 新聞稿（6-K Exhibit 99.1，2026-10-01）：拿到約 450 MW 表後燃氣發電機組設計製造案（北美資料中心開發商），2027 年開始交貨、2028 年完成

sources.quote: The Company has been contracted to design, engineer, fabricate, and assemble approximately 450 megawatts of behind-the-meter natural gas-fired power generation units for a North American data center developer.
The project will be executed through Enerflex's North American manufacturing operations with deliveries scheduled to commence in 2027 and be completed in 2028.
